title: Naturally Smoky Peruvian Lamb Seco De Cordero
description: A funky and crunchy Peruvian dish featuring black cardamom pods and tandoor smoked lamb, perfect for a date night. This seco de cordero recipe combines the bold flavors of Peru with the tenderness of slow cooked lamb.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the crushed black cardamom pods, minced garlic, grated ginger, tandoor spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then remove from heat.
Add the red wine vinegar to the Dutch oven and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the lamb shoulder to the Dutch oven, cover, and transfer to the preheated tandoor or oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove the lamb from the tandoor or oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
